description: Read a meeting's transcript -- what was actually said in the room. Use this whenever someone asks about the CONTENT of a meeting: what was decided, who said what, what a number was, what someone committed to. get_meeting_agenda returns a meeting's structure; this returns its words. Long transcripts arrive one window at a time -- if next_offset comes back there is more, so keep reading before you answer. When has_transcript is false, say plainly that no transcript is attached rather than guessing at what was said. This tool is off unless the organization's Owner has enabled transcript reading; if it refuses, relay that plainly and say the Owner can turn it on in Settings, Redaction. Never imply the refusal is a bug or that you can work around it.

offset.description: Character offset to read from. Omit to start at the beginning; pass the next_offset from the previous call to continue.

name: get_meeting_transcript
